name: tag-input
title: Tag Input
description: A text field that collects multiple tags, with a two-step Backspace removal and an optional limit.

useCases: Collecting keywords, topics, skills, labels, or email recipients as a list of short tags in forms.
limitations: Tags are plain trimmed strings added at the end; duplicates are rejected case-insensitively. No suggestions, reordering, or inline editing of existing tags.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Phosphor icons, the shadcn label component, and theme colors. Supply a label. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion removes the shake and transitions.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/tag-input.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
